title: 🟣 Fred · Command Center
description: Discord-Statistik, Weltkarte, Kameras, Homelab und Jarvis auf einen Blick.

options.content:
FRED · COMMAND CENTER

Dialog der Religionen · Discord · Weltlage · Kameras · Homelab · Jarvis

🤖 Jarvis 🌍 Lagebild 🚀 Sissyphus CC 🛡️ Ziti ☸️ Headlamp 🐙 Gitea

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM fred_archiv_oeffentlich WHERE zeit > UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND bot = 0 AND user_id <> 1413591205047959674 AND geloescht IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM fred_archiv_oeffentlich WHERE zeit > UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND user_id = 1413591205047959674
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS n FROM fred_archiv_oeffentlich WHERE zeit > UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND bot = 0 AND user_id <> 1413591205047959674 AND geloescht IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM fred_voice_sitzungen WHERE ende IS NULL AND zuletzt > UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(zeit, '1h'), SUM(bot = 0 AND user_id <> 1413591205047959674) AS Menschen, SUM(user_id = 1413591205047959674) AS Fred FROM fred_archiv_oeffentlich WHERE $__timeFilter(zeit) AND geloescht IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(zeit, '1d'), COUNT(*) AS Nachrichten, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS Köpfe FROM fred_archiv_oeffentlich WHERE $__timeFilter(zeit) AND bot = 0 AND user_id <> 1413591205047959674 AND geloescht IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT MAX(name) AS Name, COUNT(*) AS Nachrichten FROM fred_archiv_oeffentlich WHERE $__timeFilter(zeit) AND bot = 0 AND user_id <> 1413591205047959674 AND geloescht IS NULL GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY Nachrichten DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT MAX(kanal) AS Kanal, COUNT(*) AS Nachrichten FROM fred_archiv_oeffentlich WHERE $__timeFilter(zeit) AND bot = 0 AND user_id <> 1413591205047959674 AND geloescht IS NULL GROUP BY kanal_id ORDER BY Nachrichten DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: 🔥 Wann ist Betrieb? · 30 Tage, Ortszeit
panels.description: Nachrichten je Wochentag und Stunde der letzten 30 Tage (Europe/Berlin).

targets.rawSql: SELECT LPAD(HOUR(t), 2, '0') AS Uhr, SUM(WEEKDAY(t) = 0) AS Mo, SUM(WEEKDAY(t) = 1) AS Di, SUM(WEEKDAY(t) = 2) AS Mi, SUM(WEEKDAY(t) = 3) AS Do, SUM(WEEKDAY(t) = 4) AS Fr, SUM(WEEKDAY(t) = 5) AS Sa, SUM(WEEKDAY(t) = 6) AS So FROM (SELECT CONVERT_TZ(zeit, '+00:00', 'Europe/Berlin') AS t FROM fred_archiv_oeffentlich WHERE zeit > UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND bot = 0 AND user_id <> 1413591205047959674 AND geloescht IS NULL) x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT name AS Wer, kanal AS Kanal, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, beginn, UTC_TIMESTAMP()) AS Minuten FROM fred_voice_sitzungen WHERE ende IS NULL AND zuletzt > UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE ORDER BY beginn
SELECT name AS Name, ROUND(sekunden / 3600, 1) AS Stunden FROM fred_voice_summe ORDER BY sekunden DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT username AS Name, level AS Level, xp AS XP, message_count AS Nachrichten FROM mee6_levels ORDER BY xp DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT zeit AS Zeit, name AS Wer, kanal AS Kanal, LEFT(REPLACE(REPLACE(text, '\n', ' '), '\r', ' '), 180) AS Nachricht FROM fred_archiv_oeffentlich WHERE geloescht IS NULL AND (bot = 0 OR (user_id = 1413591205047959674 AND kanal NOT LIKE '%log%')) ORDER BY zeit DESC LIMIT 25
SELECT timestamp AS Zeit, event_type AS Typ, severity AS Stufe, description AS Beschreibung FROM system_events ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 15
